source_database: ChaseLights curated Liyu Lake subject refinement B35

opportunities.name_zh: 鯉魚潭湖岸薄霧、低雲與山影氛圍
opportunities.best_time: 清晨優先；官方資料明確記載鯉魚潭清晨霧氣可形成拍攝場景
opportunities.best_season: 全年候選；官方與實拍資料均有晨霧紀錄，冬季亦有攝影實例

condition_variants.condition_geometry: {"camera_zone":"鯉魚潭潭北／環潭公共水岸 Camera Zone","subject":"lake mist + near shoreline + partial mountain silhouettes"}
condition_variants.hard_gates: 合法公共湖岸可達；無豪雨或現場封閉；低能見度不得等同道路或步道安全無虞
condition_variants.required_conditions: 清晨優先；近中距離湖岸仍可辨；無明顯降雨；能見度偏低且預報具霧／高濕／低雲訊號。氣象條件只用來判斷已驗證霧景題材何時較可能成立，不用來證明景點本身適合霧景。
condition_variants.boosters: 清晨；能見度約 0.2–3 km 且高濕／低雲訊號支持；弱風；局部山影若隱若現
condition_variants.penalties: 大雨；強風驅散霧氣；高能見度且無霧訊號；霧濃到近岸主體亦不可辨；僅有地形條件而無實際霧訊號

viewpoints.note: Mist subject is admitted because Liyu Lake itself has documented morning-mist / haze observations; this is not inferred from basin or lake terrain alone. Camera Zone remains representative, not an exact tripod point.
viewpoints.name: 鯉魚潭潭南碼頭晨霧 Camera Zone
viewpoints.geometry_note: 代表合法公共湖岸霧景構圖區；霧景題材有官方實景描述支持，不是由地形推定；不宣稱唯一腳架位置。

opportunities.evidence_summary: Location-specific sources describe actual morning mist/haze at Hualien Liyu Lake, including Forestry and Nature Conservation Agency imagery text ('晨霧氤氳' / '煙嵐飄渺') and documented photographer observations of winter morning mist. Runtime visibility/humidity thresholds are forecast proxies, not geomorphology-derived proof.

subject_evidence.note: 霧景題材不是由湖盆地形或高濕條件推論；花東縱谷國家風景區管理處明確描述鯉魚潭清晨霧氣為拍攝場景，林業及自然保育署官方影像資料亦記錄晨霧氤氳與煙嵐飄渺。

opportunities.name_zh: 鯉魚潭人工濕地與水岸近景細節
opportunities.best_time: 日間柔光；陰天、雨後或高濕時亦適合

condition_variants.variant_name: 人工濕地、水岸植被與近景紋理
condition_variants.condition_geometry: {"camera_zone":"鯉魚潭人工濕地／環潭水岸 Camera Zone","subject":"wetland habitat + waterside vegetation + reflections + close-range natural details"}
condition_variants.hard_gates: 合法公共或環境教育動線可達；不得進入濕地或干擾野生動物
condition_variants.required_conditions: 公共觀察位置可達；降雨未造成通行風險；近景植被與水岸細節可辨
condition_variants.boosters: 陰天柔光；雨後飽和綠意；水滴、倒影與濕地紋理；低風
condition_variants.penalties: 豪雨；強風；積水或濕滑造成通行風險；為追逐動物而離開合法動線

viewpoints.note: Official environmental-education wetland habitat is the subject basis; actual wildlife presence is never guaranteed.
viewpoints.name: 鯉魚潭人工濕地／環潭水岸近景 Camera Zone
viewpoints.geometry_note: 代表人工濕地與環潭合法觀察區；適合植被、水岸、反射與棲地細節，不要求長距離能見度。
